categories.main_business_segments: Dacin Engineering Co., Ltd. primarily operates in construction and engineering services, including civil engineering, road, bridge, harbor, painting, waterproofing, grouting, prestressed concrete, ready-mixed concrete, new town and urban development, urban renewal, and related design and construction services. The company also engages in real estate development projects and investment construction, focusing on residential, commercial office buildings, public infrastructure, and high-tech factory buildings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction technologies such as BIM (Building Information Modeling), smart construction site management, and low-carbon construction methods. It has developed patented precast SRC (Steel Reinforced Concrete) construction methods and integrates design, engineering, and construction management to provide total solutions. The company emphasizes quality control, environmental sustainability, and safety management systems including ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies for public infrastructure projects, private developers for residential and commercial buildings, and high-tech manufacturers such as TSMC for factory construction. The company serves sectors including public works, industrial plants, commercial offices, residential housing, and urban renewal projects, with a strong focus on high-tech industry clients and large-scale public infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with significant projects in major cities such as Taipei, Taichung, Hsinchu, and Kaohsiung. It also has overseas investments and operations in Vietnam, Singapore, Malaysia, and other Southeast Asian countries through subsidiaries and holding companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dacin Engineering operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain, acting as a general contractor and project developer. It coordinates upstream suppliers of construction materials and machinery while delivering integrated construction and development services to end customers and investors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening expertise in high-tech factory construction, expanding urban renewal and BOT projects, and enhancing smart construction technologies such as BIM and IoT-based site management. The company invests in R&D for low-carbon construction methods, precast components, and sustainable building practices, aiming to improve operational efficiency, environmental performance, and safety standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based construction contracts, including public tenders and private development projects. Additional income comes from real estate development and investment returns. The company also benefits from long-term contracts with major clients and diversified project portfolios to stabilize cash flow.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dacin Engineering is positioned as a leading large-scale construction and development firm in Taiwan with a strong reputation for quality and reliability. It competes with other major domestic construction companies, leveraging its integrated design-build capabilities, financial strength, and long-term relationships with key clients like TSMC. Its focus on innovation and sustainability differentiates it in a competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$14.69 billion, with a net profit after tax of about NT$1.32 billion, showing growth compared to the previous year. Total assets reached nearly NT$28 billion, with equity attributable to owners around NT$9.77 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by strong project backlogs and diversified business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dacin Engineering emphasizes comprehensive engineering solutions integrating design, construction, and project management with a focus on quality, safety, and sustainability. Its competitive advantages include advanced technological adoption (BIM, smart construction), strong financial and operational capabilities, and a proven track record with high-profile clients in high-tech and public sectors. The company’s commitment to environmental responsibility and employee welfare further enhances its brand value and client trust.
